patch:
diff --git a/docs/results/2026-08-21-sm120a-muse-consolidation-campaign.md b/docs/results/2026-08-21-sm120a-muse-consolidation-campaign.md
index 6c58c4b2..945b835a 100644
--- a/docs/results/2026-08-21-sm120a-muse-consolidation-campaign.md
+++ b/docs/results/2026-08-21-sm120a-muse-consolidation-campaign.md
@@ -84,3 +84,31 @@ tests passed, and the 8K and 129,041-token Engine sentinels retrieved the exact
 DFlash2 k4 and INT8-G64 KV. The new C40 W8 selection is limited to the qualified `sm_120a` image;
 the package also cross-compiles in the `sm_86` and `sm_89` images without changing their dispatch.
 Candidate source commits are `a1d20707` and qualification-containment commit `19687307`.
+
+## Cycle 2 retained baseline and profile
+
+Cycle 2 starts at `e5036052`, whose source is the accepted cycle-1 package. Five warmups and 31
+measured rounds produced the following matrix. C8 was repeated three times; the fastest warm
+control, 40.5895 ms, is the conservative decision baseline, so both candidate repetitions must be
+39.7777 ms or less.
+
+| Boundary | GPU ms/round | Aggregate published tok/s |
+|---|---:|---:|
+| 8K C1 | 29.1602 | 153.502 |
+| 8K C2 | 33.2746 | 269.093 |
+| 8K C3 | 36.7056 | 365.991 |
+| 8K C4 | 37.8113 | 473.676 |
+| 8K C5 | 43.7362 | 512.112 |
+| 8K C6 | 44.8544 | 599.085 |
+| 8K C7 | 42.0698 | 745.205 |
+| 8K C8, decision control | 40.5895 | 882.783 |
+| 8K C8, other controls | 41.9006 / 41.6524 | 855.042 / 860.397 |
+| 129,041 C1 | 32.9609 | 30.2988 |
+
+A fresh Nsight Systems 2025.5.2 capture attributes 31.81 ms to Q4: 12.85 ms in the N19968
+R64/C40 activation-cache route, 18.96 ms in broad R32/C40 shapes, and 0.97 ms in the selective
+R16 small outputs. The accepted W8 C40 head is 2.04 ms across target and draft launches; GQA is
+4.03 ms and the remaining kernels are individually sub-millisecond. Cycle 2 therefore has no
+single rejected ledger component with a measured standalone ceiling above the 0.812 ms gate.
+Candidates must combine complementary mechanisms or have a concrete same-kernel interaction
+rationale; overlapping savings are not treated as additive by default.

+## Cycle 2 terminal result
+
+All 24 authorized packages were committed, tested through the narrow-to-real gate appropriate to
+their evidence, recorded, and reverted when rejected. No package was accepted, so this full no-win
+cycle terminates the consolidation campaign under the frozen rule. The retained implementation is
+exactly the accepted cycle-1 source; there is no source difference from `e5036052` under `src/`,
+`include/`, `tests/`, `bench/`, or the root build definition.

+The first seven cycle-2 packages were built without explicitly naming the standalone public
+benchmark in the incremental build target, leaving the benchmark executable's relink provenance
+ambiguous. Candidates 8-14 applied the exact same seven source patches (verified by stable Git
+patch ID), explicitly rebuilt `ginfer_linear_bench`, and independently reproduced the decisions.
+The immutable candidate rows remain intact; the machine-readable
+[correction map](2026-08-21-sm120a-muse-consolidation-corrections.csv) identifies every affected
+row, its exact validating row, the corrected measurement, and the unchanged decision.
+
+The strongest measured combination directions after provenance correction rank as follows:
+
+| Rank | Valid package evidence | Optimistic saving at current baseline | Terminal observation |
+|---:|---|---:|---|
+| 1 | Candidate 23: N19968 two-block/ping-pong plus broad three-stage/three-block | public domains approached the 0.812 ms gate | the first real C8 round regressed from 40.5895 to 42.2354 ms (-4.0550%); cold gains reverse in the warm mixed schedule |

+head from 1004.864 to 1508.640 us, and relaxing its four-block bound regressed it to 1051.904 us.

+loads, dual-cache admission, and the complete latency package all materially regressed their public
+domain. Those mechanisms overlap occupancy, L1, or issue resources rather than contributing a
+disjoint additive saving. No remaining measured combination has a defensible additive ceiling at
+or above 0.812 ms.

+
+The terminal matrix uses the same five warmups and 31 measured rounds. Relative to the

+
